channel.description: Shapes Shape Tools Reference Name Icon Description Rectangle Creates a rectangular shape. Ellipse Creates an elliptical shape. Text Creates a text element. Image Creates an image element. Context Menu Edit move scale rotate Image picker for rectangle for insntace, you can set an image (.png) to image > imageFile property with the imageFolder imageFile: title2.png imageFolder: App/shape/asset/image For convinience, you can click imageFile property, and Thumnail appears for you to select one. The images in the thumbnail panel are retrived from App/{{book}}/assets/{{page}}/images folder. You can manually copy&paste your images to the assets/{{page}}/images folder
